items.prompt: Kiedyś codziennie ___ kawę. (I used to drink coffee every day.)
items.explanation: A habit (codziennie) takes the imperfective: piłam.
optionNotes: Będę never goes with a perfective infinitive.
The perfective is for one finished drink, not a habit.
Wypiję is the future: "I'll drink it up".

items.prompt: Wczoraj ___ nowy telefon. (I bought a new phone.)
items.explanation: One finished purchase takes the perfective: kupiłem.
optionNotes: Kupowałem means "I was buying" or "I used to buy".

items.prompt: What is the perfective partner of brać (take)?
items.explanation: Brać / wziąć is a pair of two different verbs.
optionNotes: Brać się is a different verb with się.
Not a word: you cannot guess the prefix.

items.explanation: Cały wieczór (all evening) is about how long: imperfective, oglądaliśmy.
optionNotes: The perfective shows a finished result, not how long.
